User Story: As a Loan Officer, I want customer identity verified automatically so that application checks are completed faster.
As a Compliance Officer, I want failed KYC cases routed to manual review so that regulatory exceptions are handled safely.
As a Credit Analyst, I want affordability calculated using verified income and commitments so that decisions are consistent.
As an Underwriter, I want high-risk applications sent to manual review so that risk controls are maintained.
As an Operations Analyst, I want approved loans created automatically so that duplicate data entry is removed.
As a Finance Analyst, I want daily payment files imported so that collections data is available on time.
As a Finance Analyst, I want mismatched payments flagged daily so that reconciliation discrepancies reduce.
As an Operations Manager, I want exceptions assigned by category and SLA so that ownership is clear.
As an Investor Reporting Manager, I want a daily portfolio dataset so that investor reports are not delayed.
As a Leadership user, I want Power BI KPIs refreshed daily so that decision-making is based on current data.
